landing.title: Plan the trip. <1>Split the costs.</1>
landing.subtitle: TripShare brings together the itinerary, places, bookings and the group's expenses. AI drafts the plan, reads receipts and tells you who owes whom.

plan.title: Day-by-day plan
plan.text: Times, transfers, places with maps and links, rainy-day backups.

split.title: Splitwise-style expenses
split.text: Equal parts, shares, percentages or per item. In multiple currencies.

ai.title: AI that works for you
ai.text: Drafts the itinerary, checks opening hours and turns receipts and screenshots into expenses.

settle.title: Settle up in a few steps
settle.text: The fewest possible transfers, with prefilled PayPal links.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.text: Install it on your phone: plan and expenses always at hand, even without signal.

together.title: Everyone in the same trip
together.text: Invite friends with a link: they sign up and join the trip right away.

steps.title: Create the trip
steps.text: Pick dates, currency and a cover photo, or let the AI draft it.

steps.title: Invite the group
steps.text: Share the link: whoever opens it signs up and is in.

steps.title: Log expenses
steps.text: Snap the receipt, the AI fills in the expense with emoji and category.

steps.title: Settle up
steps.text: TripShare works out who owes whom, with the fewest payments.

landing.finalText: Free, in English and Italian, on your own server.

modelPurposes.vision: Reads receipts and booking screenshots: needs a model that accepts images.

modelPurposes.light: Short, cheap tasks: categories, emoji, packing list.
